title: VibeFlow tenant/resource authorization boundary
head_binding_policy: Acceptance binds to the exact final pushed PR head reported at handoff; every later push invalidates prior exact-head review.
dependency_decision: No external authorization engine is introduced for this slice. The M-010 decision boundary is plain TypeScript over the canonical PostgreSQL authority (organization_memberships). OpenFGA and peers remain candidate/reference only; nothing is added just because the capability ledger names one.

boundary: packages/authorization/src/types.ts - typed decision boundary (ResourceRef, AuthorizationRequest, AuthorizationDecision, DenyReason)
packages/authorization/src/decision.ts - pure deny-by-default request validation (canonical UUIDs, registered resource-type/action tokens)
packages/authorization/src/service.ts - TenantAuthorizationService resolving membership from canonical persistence on every decision
security_controls: authorization is server-side and deny-by-default; every malformed/unknown/unauthorized input yields an explicit deny decision
authentication (M-009) proves only Account identity; the boundary never treats it as an implicit Organization/resource grant
membership and resource relationships are resolved from canonical VibeFlow persistence on every decision
client/provider-supplied organization ids, roles, permissions, ownership claims, and resource relationships are never trusted as authority
resource type and action are validated against registered canonical tokens; unknown types/actions fail closed
canonical VibeFlow UUIDs are required; client/provider/scoped identifiers are rejected
P0 negative tests prove IDOR and cross-tenant reads and mutations fail closed
the request boundary carries no client-claimed organizationId field; the tenant is resolved from persistence
implementation.non_authority_statement: M-010 does not implement Project ownership/persistence (M-012), roles/group binding, or full resource policy; those are not claimed here. VF-IAM-010 remains NOT_STARTED until canonical Project authority exists.

capability_status.VF-IAM-010: NOT_STARTED (Project ownership requires canonical Project authority in M-012; not claimed)
capability_status.VF-IAM-011: IN_PROGRESS - typed deny-by-default tenant/resource decision boundary implemented and tenant-isolation tested; full resource policy remains pending
capability_status.VF-IAM-016: IN_PROGRESS (unchanged; canonical Organization + Membership authority underpins this boundary)

local_database_result.reason: The Arena workspace has no PostgreSQL service. The runner emits an explicit NOT EXECUTED message; it does not treat the skipped suite as verification.

ci_requirement.condition: CI fails if DATABASE_URL and VIBEFLOW_DATABASE_URL are both absent; otherwise it runs the M-010 live suite directly.
ci_requirement.ci_workflow_step: The runner is invoked by `pnpm run check` (the repository-foundation workflow 'Run foundation check' step), which supplies PostgreSQL 18.4 via DATABASE_URL. No workflow file edit is required; the builder GitHub App lacks `workflows` permission.
required_cases: authenticated account denied outside its own tenant (IDOR mutation)
ci_requirement.candidate_binding: The final protected CI record must match the final PR head. This file does not preclaim a future CI result.
